title: Ostomy Supply Program Shipping Fees and Delivery Service Levels
content:
These are the Ostomy Supply Program's shipping fees and delivery service levels per payer tier: what standard and expedited shipping cost, when a package is declared lost, how many courtesy reships a program receives, the windows for reporting damage and defects, and whether a signature is required on delivery.

## Terms

- **Standard shipping fee** - the fee for standard ground shipping of a refill below the free-shipping threshold, in USD.
- **Free-shipping threshold** - the shipment cash-price total, in USD, at or above which standard shipping is free; 0.00 means standard shipping is always free.
- **Expedited shipping fee** - the fee for customer-requested expedited (two-day) shipping, in USD; it is never billed to a payer.
- **Carrier trace period** - the trace period, in business days (Monday-Friday excluding US federal holidays) after the carrier's expected delivery date, after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit.
- **Courtesy reships** - the number of no-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive, counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date.
- **Damage report window** - the window for reporting a package damaged in transit, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Defect report window** - the window for reporting a box that was defective as shipped (wrong size or cut, wrong system, broken seal, recalled lot), in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Signature on delivery** - whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of an ostomy package.

## Service levels by tier

| Tier | Standard shipping fee | Free-shipping threshold | Expedited fee | Trace period | Courtesy reships | Damage window | Defect window | Signature required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | USD 6.95 | USD 75.00 | USD 24.50 | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | No |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | No |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | No |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | No |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | No |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 (always free) | USD 24.50 | 3 business days | 1 | 7 days | 30 days | No |

## Reading the table

- Standard shipping carries a fee only on the Ostomy Self-Pay Program: USD 6.95 when the shipment's cash-price total is below USD 75.00, and nothing when it reaches USD 75.00.
- The expedited shipping fee of USD 24.50 is the same on every tier.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a self-pay shipment with a cash-price total of USD 74.99 carries the USD 6.95 standard shipping fee; one totalling exactly USD 75.00 ships free.
